raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-AFW-HealthSecurityPhase3",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Ongoing armed conflict, civil unrest, and security instability in fragile areas (such as CAR, Chad, and Cameroon's North-West/South-West) could disrupt project execution, restrict physical access, and compromise health service delivery.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and implement Security Risk Assessments (SRAs) and Security Management Plans (SMPs), adopt flexible implementation approaches in FCV zones, and engage local community partners for decentralized delivery.",
      "evidence": "Fragility in AFW is exacerbated by conflict and violence... Political instability, particularly in the North-West and South-West regions, may disrupt service delivery"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Macro-fiscal instability, high public debt burdens, and declining national revenues across participating countries could lead to domestic funding shortfalls and jeopardize the financial sustainability of health security systems.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide technical assistance to integrate health security into national Medium-Term Expenditure Frameworks, establish budget coding and tracking, and leverage domestic resource mobilization and public-private partnerships.",
      "evidence": "A challenging macro-fiscal outlook... declining oil revenues... RoC's high debt burden limits public investment in health"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Weak procurement capacity, complex market conditions in fragile settings, and governance bottlenecks could cause significant procurement delays, cost overruns, and supply chain disruptions for critical medical and laboratory commodities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit experienced procurement specialists, deploy mandatory rated criteria for bidding, conduct early market engagements, strengthen contract management systems, and utilize STEP for real-time tracking.",
      "evidence": "Procurement Risks include delays, governance issues, weak contract management, and limited market competition in fragile settings."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Inadequate financial management capacity, decentralized project activities in hard-to-reach areas, and multi-agency execution increase the risk of financial control failures, delayed reporting, and ineligible or questionable expenditures.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Customize project accounting software, update financial management manuals, perform quarterly risk-based internal audits, retain qualified financial staff, and submit annual audited project financial statements.",
      "evidence": "The overall FM residual risk rating is assessed as Substantial... activities under the project like workshops, trainings... generate questionable expenditures in Cameroon"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Increasing climate vulnerability and extreme weather events, such as severe flooding and droughts, risk damaging healthcare infrastructure and escalating vector-borne and waterborne disease outbreaks across the sub-region.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce EDGE level 1 energy-efficiency and climate-resilience standards for facility refurbishments, integrate climate hazard data into early warning surveillance systems, and update health sector contingency plans.",
      "evidence": "Climate change is a primary driver of health emergencies in Central Africa... More frequent flooding events in CAR and Chad drive recurrent cholera outbreaks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Improper management, handling, and disposal of hazardous biological, chemical, and infectious healthcare and laboratory waste generated during disease testing could result in environmental contamination and public health risks.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Update and implement national Healthcare and Biomedical Waste Management Plans, enforce strict biosafety protocols in project laboratories, and train staff on safe hazardous waste disposal.",
      "evidence": "laboratories will be supplied with reagents, chemicals, and equipment that may constitute medical waste once used."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "The expansion of frontline health workforces and civil works labor influx in local communities creates substantial risks of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse and Sexual Harassment (SEA/SH).",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop and enforce country-specific SEA/SH Action Plans, hire dedicated gender/GBV specialists in PIUs, establish GBV-sensitive grievance redress mechanisms, and mandate worker codes of conduct.",
      "evidence": "The overall project SEA/SH risks are judged to be substantial... increased presence of new health workforce... may create concerns of Sexual exploitation and abuse"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Inadequate community engagement and consultation risks excluding vulnerable and marginalized populations—such as IDPs, refugees, rural women, and underserved groups—from project benefits and emergency health communications.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare, consult upon, and implement country-specific Stakeholder Engagement Plans (SEPs), deploy accessible Grievance Redress Mechanisms (GRMs), and conduct inclusive Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) outreach.",
      "evidence": "Potential social risks are substantial and relate to: (i) inadequate stakeholder engagement... (ii) the exclusion of vulnerable or disadvantaged groups"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "The digitization of disease surveillance and cross-border health data sharing without adequate privacy safeguards could expose sensitive personal health data to security breaches and non-compliance with data protection laws.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish standardized ethical data security and privacy protocols, ensure alignment with national data protection legislation, and integrate secure access controls into digital health platforms.",
      "evidence": "inadequate attention to ensure that guidelines established under the Program include considerations for and ethical data security protocols"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Weak inter-ministerial coordination and fragmented institutional structures across human, animal, and environmental sectors could impede the effective operationalization of the One Health approach.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Operationalize multisectoral National Steering Committees and technical committees, establish formal One Health coordination platforms, and execute formal inter-agency MoUs.",
      "evidence": "gaps are primarily due to limited domestic and regional resources, weak institutional capacities and governance mechanisms, and insufficient multisectoral coordination."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Severe shortages of specialized technical personnel and gender disparities in epidemiological and veterinary roles could limit national and subnational capacity to detect and manage public health threats.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Expand Field Epidemiology Training Programs (FETP) and veterinary epidemiology (ISAVET) courses while implementing targeted outreach and gender targets to train and deploy female health workers.",
      "evidence": "women remain underrepresented in formal epidemiological training and decision-making... gaps in laboratory diagnostic capabilities... and the health workforce's ability"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Bureaucratic and political bottlenecks in negotiating and adopting regional frameworks, sample transfer protocols, and data-sharing agreements across CEMAC member states could delay sub-regional health emergency responses.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize CEMAC's institutional mandate and the Regional Coordination Committee (RCC) to harmonize policies, standardize regional biosafety regulations, and expedite cross-border operational agreements.",
      "evidence": "Political and administrative inefficiencies could slow project execution."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Land acquisition, civil works, or construction/rehabilitation of health facilities and laboratories could cause temporary economic displacement or minor land use restrictions for local communities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct thorough environmental and social screening of all sub-projects, prepare site-specific Resettlement Plans where necessary, and prioritize existing government land to prevent physical displacement.",
      "evidence": "Potential social risks... land acquisition impacts associated with new constructions... Resettlement Plans and Indigenous Peoples plan as needed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Inadequate laboratory equipment maintenance, supply chain delays for diagnostic reagents, and weak quality management systems could lead to diagnostic inaccuracies or failure during major disease outbreaks.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish interconnected national/regional laboratory networks, support WHO SLIPTA quality accreditation, enforce biosafety/biosecurity guidelines, and finance equipment maintenance contracts.",
      "evidence": "region commonly faces significant gaps in laboratory diagnostic capabilities... quality control, biosafety & biosecurity"
    }
  ]
}
